tasks.label: build
args: $javac = $null; if ($env:JAVA_HOME -and (Test-Path "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin\javac.exe")) { $javac = "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin\javac.exe" } elseif (Test-Path "C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium") { $latestJdk = Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium" -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($latestJdk -and (Test-Path "$($latestJdk.FullName)\bin\javac.exe")) { $javac = "$($latestJdk.FullName)\bin\javac.exe" } }; if (-not $javac) { throw 'No se encontró javac. Instala un JDK o configura JAVA_HOME.' }; if (!(Test-Path out)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory out | Out-Null }; $files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.java src | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; & $javac -cp "lib/*" -d out $files

tasks.label: run
args: $java = $null; if ($env:JAVA_HOME -and (Test-Path "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin\java.exe")) { $java = "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin\java.exe" } elseif (Test-Path "C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium") { $latestJdk = Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium" -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($latestJdk -and (Test-Path "$($latestJdk.FullName)\bin\java.exe")) { $java = "$($latestJdk.FullName)\bin\java.exe" } }; if (-not $java) { throw 'No se encontró java. Instala un JDK o configura JAVA_HOME.' }; & $java -cp "out;lib/*" app.Main
